title: objectives/prediction@1 — counterfactual prediction record (COG-3)
description: A counterfactual prediction / forecast record (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-3-contract-2026-07-22.md §4.3) — an ORIGINAL record in its OWN store (cabinet/cache/objectives/predictions/), NOT a projection, EXCLUDED from N1 by name. prediction_id is pinned pred-<recorder-digest>: the `pred-` prefix makes the schema wall REAL — the belief-id pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ (edge.v1.json evidence_bindings) and the prediction-id pattern ^pred-[0-9a-f]{64}$ are DISJOINT by construction, so a prediction id is structurally unciteable as evidence (wall a of the three independent walls). Scoring a prediction later yields a prediction-accuracy record that lands ONLY in this store — never auto-promoted to evidence. Registry-PATH-resolved but validated with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator (pattern is outside the closed-subset registry interpreter).

prediction_id.description: pred-<recorder-digest> — disjoint from the belief-id namespace by construction (§4.3)

edge_id.description: The causal edge this prediction is about (belief-id-shaped digest)

assumption_set.description: The explicit assumption-override set of the counterfactual branch

cutoff.description: The canonical cutoff the prediction was minted at

made_at_epoch.description: The graph epoch tuple the prediction was minted under (recorded, not a projection)
